method: Same release profile, tools, path normalization and optimizer as the main measurement. Profile builds retain function names; their code/data section sizes exactly match the stripped reference artifacts. egui-only workload constructs the same window, label and slider and tessellates without mikage/winit. wgpu is an unused direct dependency in the isolated test harness.
limitations: Function name grouping is shallow attribution after optimization; inlined/shared code can be attributed to callers. The isolated program differs from the full renderer fixture, so its size delta is corroboration, not an exact additive decomposition.
scope: Earlier controlled experiment: WebGL was excluded by patching exported dependency feature declarations. These full-fixture values are not the current default-feature baselines.
